purpose: Search public independently authored sources for traceable instances of a versioned executable policy at a model-mediated decision boundary.
credential_policy: Use authenticated GitHub read access without recording tokens, cookies, account identifiers, private repository results, or credentials.

formal_search_boundary.prior_searches: Exploratory scoping only. A source seen during scoping is eligible only if it is returned by a frozen formal query or an explicitly declared citation-chain expansion.
source_types: public commits, issues, pull requests, releases, and tests
formal_search_boundary.deduplication_key: repository full name, then fixed commit and path

citation_chain_rule: For every repository returned by a frozen query, follow only its own README, documentation, commit history, releases, issues, pull requests, tests, and directly cited upstream source. Record each expansion and its relationship to the seed result.

inclusion_criteria.I1_public_fixed_source: The evidence is public and can be fixed to a commit, release, issue, archival publication, or versioned official document.
inclusion_criteria.I2_model_service_path: Executable code or authoritative system documentation establishes a model or model-service call in the relevant decision path.
inclusion_criteria.I3_versioned_policy: The path consumes, selects, or enforces an identifiable executable policy, guardrail, rule configuration, or immutable policy version.
inclusion_criteria.I4_downstream_action: The path produces or gates a finite downstream action, such as allow, block, hold, route, escalate, or tool execution.
inclusion_criteria.I5_historical_change_or_fault: A time-stamped revision, bug, issue, regression test, or release note establishes a behavioral policy or interface change.
inclusion_criteria.I6_replayable_or_auditable: The old and new behavior, test, or failure can be replayed or independently audited without private credentials or unverifiable claims.
inclusion_criteria.I7_provenance_and_license: Authorship, source coordinates, and license or quotation boundary permit the proposed artifact use.

outcome_classes.EXCLUDED: Fails the minimum criteria for all three retained evidence classes.

decision_rule.go: At least one QUALIFYING_ROUTE_REVISION is found and survives fixed-source replay or audit.
decision_rule.limited_go: No complete route revision is found, but independent architecture and policy-revision evidence are both found. Report the two evidence classes separately and retain the deployment-incidence limitation.
decision_rule.no_go: No qualifying route revision and no defensible complementary evidence chain are found. Do not run model calls or claim external validation.

post_freeze_model_budget.scored_call_formula: eligible revision cases * 2 policy states * 2 frozen routes * 3 repetitions
